name: TOYO Corporation
summary: TOYO Corporation provides measurement solutions in Japan. The company provides advanced measurement technologies for energy; equipment and solutions for measurement, analysis, and experimental data management to support research and development of transportation equipment such as automobiles and trains, as well as noise and vibration, and safety and durability of industrial machinery; and standard compliance testing services and solutions.
